name: Awei TA17 ANC True Wireless Earbuds ( 6-Month Official Warranty )
description:
Experience crystal-clear calls, deep bass, and all-day comfort with the Awei TA17 ANC Earbuds. Equipped with Bluetooth 6.0, ANC noise reduction, and ergonomic design, these earbuds are perfect for music, gaming, calls, and daily use.

Key Features

Bluetooth 6.0: Ultra-stable, low-latency connection for uninterrupted music and calls.

Active Noise Cancellation (ANC): Block external noise for clear calls even in loud environments.

HD Sound Quality: 10mm drivers deliver crisp vocals, deep bass, and immersive audio.

Ergonomic Fit: Lightweight design (41.7g) ensures comfort for long listening sessions.

Long Battery Life:

Earbuds: 40mAh each

Charging Case: 400mAh

Music Playback: ~7 hours

Talk Time: ~6 hours

Fast Charging: Type-C charging method, fully charged in 1.5 hours.

Compact & Portable: Size 58.8 × 49.4 × 26.3mm for easy carrying.

Package Includes

1 × Pair of Awei TA17 ANC Earbuds

1 × Charging Case

1 × USB Type-C Cable

1 × User Manual
